rooms.name: Entrance
rooms.description: A cold stone foyer. Coats hang by the door; rain drums against the windows.

rooms.name: Corridor
rooms.description: A long carpeted corridor linking the manor's ground-floor rooms.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: Shelves of ledgers and novels. A writing desk drawers shut, and a torn letter lies near the armchair.

rooms.name: Great Hall
rooms.description: A vaulted hall dominated by a tall grandfather clock, its pendulum still.

rooms.name: Study
rooms.description: Lord Blackwood's study. The wall safe hangs open; muddy prints mark the rug.

rooms.name: Garden
rooms.description: A rain-soaked kitchen garden. Mud clings to everything; a pair of field boots waits by the shed.

rooms.name: Wine Cellar
rooms.description: Cool stone vaults lined with casks. A candle stub gutters on an upturned crate.
